problem: Wi-Fi, internet or VPN connection problems
solution: Check Wi-Fi settings, restart the network adapter, verify VPN configuration and reconnect to the network.

problem: Password reset, login or locked account problems
solution: Verify the username, use the password reset procedure and contact IT support if the account remains locked.

problem: Slow, freezing or poor computer performance
solution: Restart the computer, close unnecessary applications, check available storage and run system updates.

problem: Printer connection, offline or printing problems
solution: Check printer power and network connection, verify the selected printer and restart the print service.

problem: Email sending, receiving or synchronization problems
solution: Check the internet connection, verify email settings, restart the email application and check mailbox synchronization.
